MATL_STANDARD.description: Material Standard List (MATL_STANDARD). Returns the list of available material design-standard names for a given material type; the request carries no fields (DTO_EMPTY) and the material type is supplied via the URL parameter, so the response is driven entirely by that type.

Argument.description: No request body; DTO_EMPTY takes no fields. The material type is passed as the URL parameter, not in the body.
